is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles sinensis, a malaria vector.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports Vgsc L1014F/C (kdr) and Ace-1 G119S mutations.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 and Table 2 provide genotype counts and frequencies for kdr and ace-1 mutations.

african_field_population.evidence: The study populations are from China (Anhui and Yunnan provinces), which is not in Africa.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study collecting and testing field mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies locations as Yingjiang and Lianghe Counties (Yunnan) and suburbs of Bengbu City (Anhui).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections in 2012.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study examines insecticide resistance in Anopheles sinensis populations from China. It reports on kdr and ace-1 mutations and metabolic enzyme activities, finding high resistance to multiple insecticide classes. The study is excluded because it does not involve African field populations.
